meta.title: Output Gallery
meta.description: Fixes DSH reporting produced files only after a task ends: watches your output folders live with auto-refreshing thumbnails, native file preview, and in-panel media playback over HTTP Range, so you can verify and intervene mid-task. Above the automatic asset tags (final / intermediate / input) sits a human verdict layer (finalized / redo / archive) that persists, filters and applies in batches, overriding the machine guess; region annotations merge into a feedback basket and become a decision draft you approve before sending.
